title: Non-local maintenance needs monitored authorization and session closure evidence
remediation: The deployment remote maintenance owner and security monitoring lead identify approved tools and diagnostic access in the system plan. Verify approval and strong authentication for a sampled session, retained activity and required audit events, review for anomalous behavior, and termination of the session and its network connections at completion.

milestones.title: Collect the approved system-plan scope and a redacted session authorization, authentication, audit review and termination record
